game.core.rules.readable.title: Damage, Hit Points, and Healing
game.core.rules.readable.summary: Damage resolves its typed amount through recorded immunities, resistances, vulnerabilities, and Hit Point state; healing restores only eligible Hit Points.

blocks.heading: Apply damage
items: Resolve the declared damage amount and damage type.
Apply the target's recorded immunity, resistance, or vulnerability in the required order without stacking the same response.
Apply the remaining amount to temporary Hit Points and Hit Points through the active mechanic.

blocks.heading: Healing
blocks.body: Healing applies a declared amount to the target's recorded Hit Points without exceeding its eligible maximum.

citations.locator: Playing the Game > Damage and Healing > Resistance and Vulnerability > No Stacking and Order of Application; Immunity, PDF p. 17
